parameters.name: PluginId
parameters.description: The plugin ID. This parameter is required if `UninstallPlugin` is set to `true`.

parameters.name: Restart
parameters.description: Specifies whether to restart the gateway after the channel is deleted. Default value: `true`.

parameters.name: UninstallPlugin
parameters.description: Specifies whether to uninstall the channel plugin. Default value: `false`.
